issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- Latest codes in master branch

### System information

All the platforms

### Issue description

Find the dead code snipet in AnimationMixer
Line1643, 1644 are dead codes due to `seeked` is always true.
```
player2->set_assigned_animation(anim_name);
player2->seek(at_anim_pos, true);
```
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fe01776f05b1787b28b4a270d53037a3c25f4ca2/scene/animation/animation_mixer.cpp#L1611-L1646

N/A

review_comments:
```suggestion
```
If "seeked" were always true, there would be no need for an if block in the first place.

The above is fine if you want to remove the dead code, but the correct behavior would be to leave `if (player2->is_playing())` and not remove the else block.
